essays.prompt_verbatim: What would you want your classmates to know about you that is not on your resume?

At this time how would you describe your short-term, post-MBA goal in terms of industry, function, geography, company size and/or mission and how does it align with the long-term vision you have for your career?
parts: short-term goal: industry, function, geography, company size and/or mission

essays.prompt_verbatim: If you could choose any location in the world, where would you want to travel (5 words), and why? (50 words)
parts: why (50 words); the location is the separate 5-word short answer worldwide_location

notes.text: Context: Darden Worldwide Course opportunity for full-time students

essays.prompt_verbatim: What are you excited to explore in Charlottesville?

You may use this opportunity to expand, for example, on family, medical, financial or other circumstances that will help us understand your opportunities, achievement, resilience, and impact within context.

notes.text: Paraphrase, not verbatim: a scholarship essay demonstrating leadership in innovation, technology, or entrepreneurship.

short_answers.prompt_verbatim: If you could choose any location in the world, where would you want to travel (5 words), and why? (50 words)
parts: location (5 words); the why is the essay worldwide
